problems.text: kmaudit refuses any folder that is not an OKF bundle, so docs in another layout cannot be audited.
Every folder would share one store, and concept ids are relative to their folder, so two audited folders would clash.
Nobody can see which folders have been audited.
A repository's existing audit store would be orphaned by a new store location.
Nothing stops a later guidance change from carrying old answers over through PREVIOUS_HASHES.
The verbs that write, and the agents that call them, have no way to say which namespace an answer belongs to.

goals.text: Any folder of markdown docs can be audited, each on its own.

outcomes.change: Each namespace has its own store, and every path maps to one namespace
outcomes.checked_by: tests that claims submitted for `docs` never show under `.okf` and the reverse, with one store file per namespace under `.kmaudit/`; that docs/sub/page.md and `docs/sub` mean `docs`; and that opening a folder holding an existing namespace is refused naming it

outcomes.change: Any folder of markdown docs can be audited
outcomes.checked_by: tests that `kmaudit claims todo docs` on a plain `docs/` hands out every `.md` file's sections, that a check never reads a file in the audited folder, and that the page and coverage work for it

outcomes.change: The write verbs, the agents and the skills name their namespace
outcomes.checked_by: a test that `kmaudit claims submit - --path docs` stores answers in `docs` and leaves `.okf` alone, that `todo --json` prints its namespace and a next step with `--path`, and that the agents pass `--path`

outcomes.change: kmaudit namespaces lists each namespace, its folder and counts
outcomes.checked_by: a test that `kmaudit namespaces --json` lists both namespaces with folder, sections, claims and checks

outcomes.change: The old .kmctl/audit.sqlite is copied into the .okf namespace
outcomes.checked_by: a test that a repository with only the old store opens `.okf` with every row of every table, the old file unchanged; and a run on a copy of this repository's store hands out 0 sections for `.okf`

outcomes.change: A guidance change cannot carry old answers over silently
outcomes.checked_by: a test pinning `instructions_hash()`, whose failure message says to empty PREVIOUS_HASHES
